## Proposal and provenance

Stable algorithm slug: `kind-rarity-edge-weighting`. Source: pm-4k6b note recorded 2026-08-11T14:11:06.615Z.

Signal candidate (40) — kind-rarity edge weighting, measured 2026-08-11. Candidate (39) discounts an item's structural score by the fraction of its incident edges that redundancy witnesses as implied, and while specifying it recorded the adjacent gap verbatim: centrality collapses direction AND kind before it runs, so a blocks row and a related row weigh the same. This candidate closes that gap and is complementary to (39) rather than a variant of it. (39) asks whether an edge is implied by other edges. (40) asks how much information the edge's KIND carries in this corpus.

The measurement that motivates it. Declared dependency rows on this tracker, 2026-08-11: related 6000 canonicalized, implements 2581, discovered_from 475, blocked_by 320, parent 276, verifies 245, blocks 243, supersedes 83, child 8, incident_from 4. related is 58.6 percent of the corpus and supersedes is 0.8 percent. A traversal that treats those two as interchangeable is discarding almost two orders of magnitude of discriminating power, and 482 of the related rows are reciprocal duplicates of each other, so the kind is not merely common, it is partly double-counted.

The signal. Weight an edge by the negative log of its kind's share of all declared rows, computed over the corpus being served, with reciprocal pairs of an undirected kind counted once. Rare kinds dominate a path score, common kinds contributealmost nothing. Explanation is one sentence an agent can read: this path is informative because relations of this kind are rare here.

Why it is self-correcting, which is the property that makes it worth having. Under kind-rarity weighting, adding ten thousand related edges LOWERS the weight of every related edge, including the new ones. Cheap enrichment therefore cannot buy relevance, which is exactly the failure mode pm-q6n8sj records: related is the cheapest edge to write, the only kind that never has to cite evidence, and until today the only kind with no declared bound. A bound stops dilution from passing the gate. This signal stops dilution from paying off in the ranking. The two are independent defences and both are needed, because a bound can be widened and a ranking cannot.

Degeneracy clauses, mandatory per this catalog's rules. On a corpus with one edge kind every weight is identical and the ranking is byte-identical to unweighted traversal. On a corpus with one edge the weight is a constant. On a fresh workspace with no edges the signal is not consulted. So this can never be the reason a small project ranks badly, which is the same guarantee (39) carries.

Cost. Free at the point of use. The input is edges_by_kind, which pm graph audit already computes in one pass and which is now also a declared assurance measurement per kind, so the shares are readable from the record rather than recomputed.

Route through pm-g8t7b9 with the other candidates. Do NOT weight it on the single census that surfaced it, and do not adopt it before (40) has a degeneracy test on a single-kind fixture. Open question for the portfolio owner: whether the share is computed over the whole corpus or over the served neighbourhood, because the two differ on a workspace where one subtree is densely related and the rest is not.

Scope clarification from individual-ownership review: pm-q6n8sj owns a related measurement, read primitive or defect fix. It does not independently deliver this proposed ranking behavior. Reuse its evidence and public API; evaluate the additional behavior in this experiment.

## Delivery boundary

Evaluate this mechanism as a bounded public-SDK experiment before any production adoption. Use the existing scorer and packer contracts; no CLI-only behavior or new command noun. The historical catalog is design input, not evidence that this mechanism was implemented.

## Experiment protocol

Freeze a workspace/history revision and parameter manifest. Compare against the current deterministic SDK baseline using held-out judgments and negative controls. Report nDCG/action success, critical-evidence omission, latency p50/p95, peak memory, tokens per completed task, and rebuild cost separately. Include 3-item/minutes, real-shaped, 100k/1M-item, decades-long, and sparse/dense/imbalanced graph scenarios; smoke subsets may not claim scale acceptance. Bound candidate counts, graph expansions, elapsed time, and output size, with cancellation and completeness receipts. Record exact versus approximate behavior and approximation error; theoretical guarantees require their stated assumptions. Missing or untrusted evidence remains unknown, never inferred proof.

Promotion requires a reproducible quality improvement on the held-out target population, no regression of existing exact invariants or mandatory gates, and a declared compute/token cost justified by that improvement. Reject or defer with the same immutable evidence if those conditions fail. No production default, adaptive learning, or data export is authorized by this planning item.
